terms.title: Terms of the academic demo
terms.intro: RentBuild is a university project developed by DataFlux for the Web Applications course. This landing page presents the proposal and links to a demonstration application when its address is configured.

sections.title: Purpose and scope
sections.body: The screens, equipment, plans and prices illustrate the project. This version does not offer a commercial rental service, reserve real equipment, process payments or create rental contracts. A displayed result in the demo is not confirmation of a real transaction.

sections.title: Access to the application
sections.body: The construction-company and rental-company buttons identify the intended segment when opening the separate application. This selection is a form preference and does not grant permissions. Login and registration take place there, not on this landing page. If the application is not linked, the landing displays a notice and does not create an account or simulate a successful login.

sections.title: Demonstration data
sections.body: Use fictional company details and demonstration accounts. The application currently uses a fake API for academic testing; its records and availability do not establish the state of real equipment. Data may be reset during development or redeployment.

sections.title: Forms and external services
sections.body: Contact and newsletter forms only send information if their respective endpoint is configured. Otherwise, they display an unavailable notice. Following an external application, email or social link leaves this landing page; the destination handles that interaction.

privacy.title: Privacy notice for the academic demo
privacy.intro: This notice describes the behavior implemented in this version of the RentBuild landing page. Use fictional information when testing the project.

sections.title: Language preference
sections.body: The EN/ES switch can save the selected language in your browser's localStorage under rentbuild-language. This preference stays in that browser. You can remove it through the browser's site-data settings. A document link can also select its language through the lang query parameter.

sections.title: Contact and newsletter forms
sections.body: The contact form holds the name, email and message you enter; the newsletter holds your email. These values remain in the page while you fill in the form. When an endpoint is configured and you submit, the landing sends those fields to it by POST. Without an endpoint, no form information is sent and an unavailable notice appears. This landing does not define storage or retention at a future external endpoint.

sections.title: Application access
sections.body: This landing does not request login passwords or store an authenticated user session. Segment buttons send a role query parameter to the configured application address. The separate demo application and its fake API handle any registration, session and demonstration records there.

sections.title: External requests
sections.body: The page loads fonts from Google Fonts and files from the site host. Your browser makes requests to those providers. Configured email and social links open their respective destinations. This notice does not claim a retention period or privacy policy for those external services.

about.title:
Simplifying Equipment Rental
and Management
about.body: RentBuild was created to simplify and centralize equipment rental operations. The platform helps businesses manage equipment availability, reservations, rentals, deliveries, returns, incidents, and maintenance from one place. By connecting each stage of the rental process, RentBuild provides greater control, visibility, and organization throughout the equipment lifecycle.

items.title: Equipment Management:
items.body: Register, organize, and monitor the status, location, and availability of each piece of equipment.

items.title: Rental Lifecycle Tracking:
items.body: Manage reservations, rentals, deliveries, returns, inspections, and maintenance in a connected workflow.

items.title: Maintenance Control:
items.body: Track incidents, inspections, repairs, and maintenance activities to keep equipment ready for future rentals.
